feeds.title: Go Au Pair Blog
feeds.description: Au Pair child care provides safe, reliable live-in child care and supervision of your children, while offering a valuable cultural experience for your family. Go Au Pair is an award winning Au Pair Agency offering affordable live-in child care services. Follow this blog to know about unique cultural child care exchange experience.

feeds.title: Kid Notes Blog
feeds.description: Au Pair in America is the nation's first federally approved program for U.S. families seeking au pairs to provide live-in child care over a year-long cultural exchange. Follow this blog to get information about au pair child care and cultural exchange.

feeds.title: Agent Au Pair Blog
feeds.description: The World's Most Innovative Au Pair Program. We pre-select Au Pairs who have a passion to care for children while at the same time have a desire to go abroad to improve their English and gain a better understanding of the world through American culture. Agent Au Pair offers participating au pairs an exceptional global education experience, providing a competitive advantage in future academic.

feeds.title: Fée rêvée
feeds.description: Au Pair and Semi-Pair Placement. Follow to get au pair placement information.

feeds.title: Carla's Au Pairs Blog
feeds.description: This blog is a place where we want to inspire you with stories about real Au Pairs having real experiences along with news and advices. Carla's Au Pairs recruits young people for a once in a lifetime experience as an Au Pair abroad.

feeds.title: Au Pair Extraordinaire Blog
feeds.description: Highly reputable, leading Au Pair, Tutor and Babysitter placement agency with over 2,000 Au Pairs placed since 2007. Au Pair Agency Johannesburg. Au Pair Extraordinaire has assisted families to juggle career, parenting and household responsibilities by sourcing experienced, reliable, high calibre, and exceptional au pairs.

feeds.title: FindAuPair Blog
feeds.description: FindAuPair helps families find a reliable au pair for their children. Also, it offers great au pair jobs for those who love taking care of kids and discovering a new culture and country. Our aim is to provide an honest, dedicated, cost effective and professional service.

feeds.title: Una Venezolana de Au Pair
feeds.description: I am Venezuelan 100%, I was born and raised in Caracas, I am a graphic designer, and I decided that I wanted to be an Au Pair, what better way to know another country than living there. Next US stop.

feeds.title: My Au Pair & Me Blog
feeds.description: We're Allie and Maggie, two au pair host moms looking to make a difference. We help you learn about au pairs and have a successful au pair experience so you can have more time to focus on what matters to you.

feeds.title: Adanac Au Pair Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Adanac Au Pair, Canada's best Au Pair placement agency. Adanac Au Pair is a high standard au pair placement agency that matches young foreigners into Canadian families to provide flexible, dependable, and high-quality childcare.

feeds.title: Aupair Weekend Blog
feeds.description: APW is excited to present the international student and au pair weekend program, 'Learning to Live Your American Dream,' offered in Boston, Chicago, San diego, San Francisco and Tampa Bay.

feeds.title: Smart Au Pairs Blog
feeds.description: If you are looking for an extra pair of hands to take the stress of your everyday life - our team at smartaupairs can help. Are you looking for an au pair in Australia? Smart Au Pairs is a leading International au pair agency and our team can help your family find an au pair.

feeds.title: Au Pair, Oh Paris Blog
feeds.description: Your source for everything you need to know about au pairing. Learn where to find a host family, how to become an au pair in Paris, London, Germany, and all around the world, connect with other au pairs. Au Pair, Oh Paris aims to support others through the challenges of au pair life by sharing stories & connecting au pairs.
